lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured array of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately twelve vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, demonstrating regular spatial distribution along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary high-luminance blobs, forming a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high concentration of small, high-luminance spots along its leading edge and across its visible lateral surface, which are smaller and more densely packed than those on the main flank.
